title: Registration & Check-in
description: Coffee and pastries available.

title: Welcome & Opening Remarks
description: Opening remarks from conference organizers and welcome to attendees.

title: Opening Keynote: Fire Lookouts in the Digital Age
description: This keynote explores how digital technologies are transforming our understanding and preservation of historic fire lookout structures. Drawing on case studies from across the American West, we examine the intersection of cultural heritage, environmental monitoring, and community engagement.

title: Coffee Break
description: Refreshments provided.

title: Digital Documentation Methods
description: A panel discussion on emerging methods for documenting historic lookout structures using photogrammetry, LiDAR, and other digital capture technologies.

title: Community Engagement & Oral Histories
description: Exploring methodologies for collecting and preserving oral histories from former lookout operators and local community members.

title: Lunch Break
description: On your own. See venue page for local recommendations.

title: Mapping the Network: GIS Analysis of Lookout Sightlines
description: This paper presents a comprehensive GIS analysis of fire lookout sightlines across the Northern Rockies region, examining how the historic network of lookouts created an interconnected system of visual surveillance.

title: Voices from the Tower: An Oral History Project
description: Presentation of findings from a two-year oral history project documenting the experiences of lookout operators in Idaho's Clearwater National Forest.

title: Climate Change and Historic Preservation
description: Examining the challenges of preserving historic fire lookout structures in an era of increasing wildfire risk and changing climate patterns.

title: Building Community Through Restoration
description: A case study of community-led restoration efforts at the Coolwater Lookout, demonstrating models for volunteer engagement and partnerships.

title: Afternoon Break
description: Refreshments provided.

title: Hands-on Photogrammetry Workshop
description: A practical workshop introducing participants to photogrammetry techniques for documenting historic structures. Participants should bring laptops with Meshroom installed.

title: Poster Session & Reception
description: View poster presentations while enjoying appetizers and refreshments. Cash bar available.

title: Dinner Keynote: A Life in the Lookouts
description: Join us for dinner and a keynote address from a 40-year veteran of the Forest Service who spent summers staffing lookouts across Montana and Idaho.

title: Day 2 Registration
description: Coffee available.

title: Architectural Heritage of Fire Lookouts
description: Examining the architectural significance and typologies of fire lookout structures, from the early crow's nest designs to the standardized L-4 and R-6 models.

title: Fire Lookouts in Literature and Art
description: Exploring representations of fire lookouts in literature, poetry, and visual art, from Jack Kerouac to contemporary artists.

title: Morning Break
description: Refreshments provided.

title: The Poetics of Solitude: Lookout Literature
description: An analysis of how fire lookout experiences have shaped American nature writing, focusing on themes of solitude, observation, and wilderness.

title: Preserving R-6 Flat Lookouts
description: Documentation and preservation challenges specific to the R-6 flat-style lookout towers common in the Pacific Northwest region.

title: Closing Remarks & Future Directions
description: Synthesis of conference themes and discussion of future research directions and collaborative opportunities.
